items.title: AI model upgrade available: qwen3:8b
items.brief: Qwen3 8B is a same-size local chat upgrade with stronger reasoning, tool-use support, and multi-turn instruction following than the current Llama 3.1 8B default.

aiModel.sellingPoint: Qwen3 8B is a same-size local chat upgrade with stronger reasoning, tool-use support, and multi-turn instruction following than the current Llama 3.1 8B default.
aiModel.updatePrompt: Pull qwen3:8b and set AI_CHAT_MODEL=qwen3:8b for the local chat server.
aiModel.comparison: llama3.1:8b: 4.9GB, 128K context. qwen3:8b: 5.2GB, 40K context, with Ollama library tags for tools and thinking plus stronger reasoning/tool-use positioning.
aiModel.computerSpec: 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12650H; 16 logical cores; 31.6GB RAM; Windows_NT 10.0.26200 x64. This is suitable for an 8B Ollama model in local chat.
